counting_scope: 14 representative audited pi-bearing engineering/effective rows; counts are scoped to this atlas, not an exhaustive census.

success_rows.physical_or_engineering_protocol: Index a finite set of divisions intended to exhaust one turn; measure interval and closure error.
success_rows.empirical_independence_from_other_rows: mechanical apparatus independent of S08/S09; same cycle convention
success_rows.what_survives_after_definition_stripping: finite recurrence and closure within error; π/radian removed

success_rows.physical_or_engineering_protocol: Repeat full-profile traces with artifact reindexed between traces; separate spindle and workpiece components.
success_rows.classical_effective_formula: profile deviation relative to fitted least-squares circle; θ∈[0,2π)
success_rows.empirical_independence_from_other_rows: profile channel independent of area/flow/volume apparatus
success_rows.what_survives_after_definition_stripping: repeatable boundary samples and reindexing decomposition; center/radius removed

success_rows.physical_or_engineering_protocol: Calibrate/use a wrap-length (PI-tape) device under controlled tension; optionally report derived diameter.
success_rows.where_pi_appears: π converts measured wrap length to diameter
success_rows.empirical_independence_from_other_rows: wrap measurement independent; derived D is not
success_rows.what_survives_after_definition_stripping: wrap-length repeatability survives; π-derived diameter is duplicate readout

success_rows.physical_or_engineering_protocol: Infer standardized calculated diameters from measured circumference, area, or volume.
success_rows.tolerance_or_error_envelope: inherits source measurement uncertainty; adds none
success_rows.where_pi_appears: π only in mapping C/A/V to diameter
success_rows.what_survives_after_definition_stripping: only source C/A/V survives; calculated sizes are quotient duplicates

success_rows.physical_or_engineering_protocol: Localize many aperture-edge points on a calibrated stage and compute enclosed area from the sampled boundary.
success_rows.scale_regime: roughly 0.5–50 mm aperture diameter facility range
success_rows.classical_effective_formula: ideal descriptor A=πD²/4; measured area need not use it
success_rows.where_pi_appears: π only when area is re-expressed via ideal diameter
classical_definitions_required: ideal circle only as effective descriptor
success_rows.what_survives_after_definition_stripping: stable boundary-derived area with traceable scale; circle/radius removed

success_rows.physical_or_engineering_protocol: Use a piston prover: calibrated transverse area × displacement / elapsed time.
success_rows.where_pi_appears: π only if area is replaced by ideal diameter formula
classical_definitions_required: ideal circular cross-section only if invoked
success_rows.what_survives_after_definition_stripping: transverse measure × displacement / time composes within error; π removed

success_rows.physical_or_engineering_protocol: Realize liquid volume gravimetrically from water mass/density under controlled transfer conditions.
success_rows.tolerance_or_error_envelope: expanded uncertainty ~0.33% at 3.8 L to ~0.015% at 7600 L (k=2)
success_rows.where_pi_appears: π only in optional geometric representation
success_rows.what_survives_after_definition_stripping: mass-density capacity/transfer consistency survives; ideal round formula removed

success_rows.physical_or_engineering_protocol: Measure relative time/cycle displacement of periodic signals at repeated epochs and infer drift.
success_rows.empirical_independence_from_other_rows: electronic timing independent of mechanical indexing
success_rows.what_survives_after_definition_stripping: fractional-cycle/time displacement and drift survive; radians removed

success_rows.physical_or_engineering_protocol: Generate/calibrate two sinusoidal channels with controlled relative displacement across frequency.
success_rows.scale_regime: about 1 Hz–100 kHz depending cited system
success_rows.empirical_independence_from_other_rows: hardware independent; same stripped cycle-fraction statement as S08
success_rows.what_survives_after_definition_stripping: stable relative-cycle displacement across frequency; angular unit removed

success_rows.physical_or_engineering_protocol: Transform and invert a finite cyclic sequence under a declared FFT convention.
success_rows.classical_effective_formula: A_k=Σa_m exp(-2πimk/n); inverse scale convention varies
success_rows.empirical_independence_from_other_rows: computational check, not independent physical π evidence
success_rows.what_survives_after_definition_stripping: invertible spectral decomposition survives; factor placement does not

success_rows.physical_or_engineering_protocol: Cross-correlate sampled resistor/QVNS spectra over a controlled bandwidth.
success_rows.scale_regime: wide-band JNT; ~1 Hz resolution and bandwidth approaching 1 MHz in cited NIST system
success_rows.classical_effective_formula: PSD may be per Hz or angular frequency; transform convention varies
success_rows.where_pi_appears: π moves with frequency coordinate/Fourier convention
success_rows.empirical_independence_from_other_rows: physical apparatus independent of pure FFT row
success_rows.what_survives_after_definition_stripping: band-limited noise/reference ratio survives convention changes; π placement removed

success_rows.physical_or_engineering_protocol: Apply localized laser-flash thermal excitation and measure transient relaxation/spread.
success_rows.classical_effective_formula: unbounded continuum heat kernels can carry (4παt)^(-d/2)
success_rows.what_survives_after_definition_stripping: scale/time relaxation and transport survive; Gaussian prefactor removed

success_rows.physical_or_engineering_protocol: Choose a probability model from available uncertainty information and propagate it.
success_rows.classical_effective_formula: normal density uses 1/(σ√(2π)); rectangular/triangular alternatives exist
success_rows.what_survives_after_definition_stripping: normalization/model adequacy survives; Gaussian π factor does not

success_rows.physical_or_engineering_protocol: Measure discrete acoustic/microwave resonances in one bounded cavity while tracking state/dimensions.
success_rows.tolerance_or_error_envelope: ppm/sub-ppm fractional-frequency scale depending cited system
success_rows.classical_effective_formula: examples use ω=2πf, k=nπ/L or geometry-specific eigenvalues
success_rows.where_pi_appears: π in angular/wavenumber coordinates and ideal continuum modes
success_rows.what_survives_after_definition_stripping: discrete repeatable modes and state-dependent shifts survive; π-valued target removed
